analysis.title: 3Q26 Off-Quarter SaaS Preview - Still Waiting for the Turn
key_insights: On-quarter SaaS results fell short after a strong rally into Q3 prints, with roughly two-thirds of SMID-cap SaaS stocks underperforming the index since reporting.

The AI transition requires products to move from assisting to doing work, pricing to shift from seats to consumption, and sales motions to add forward-deployed engineers, longer trials and heavier discounting. This pushes growth stabilization and reacceleration further out.
MS expects SaaS shares to take a breather into off-quarter prints, with outperformance concentrated in a selective set of names. Favored: DOCU and TTAN.

DOCU (EW, tactical positive): trades at 10x CY28 FCF, Q3 guide implies ~$12M sequential dollars added vs a $16M three-year average, and IAM customer checks were strong. A beat like 1H FY27 would lift subscription growth to 9%+ YoY.

DOCU customer checks: one customer cited a ~25-30% IAM uplift vs core eSignature spend, another a ~25% renewal increase with about half from IAM. Both favored Docusign over alternatives, though AI-native legal vendors are a longer-term threat.

TTAN (OW): HARDI data shows acceleration off June lows, Q3 weather was warmer than usual, and guidance assumes a modest GTV run-rate. MS expects a strong beat and raise, with MAX AI targeting 700 locations by year-end. Trades at 5x CY28 sales and 6x gross profit.

WDAY (UW): Agentic AI is ~$600M ARR, or 6% of total ARR, with 25% of customers using it. ARR must grow 65%+ YoY to lift consensus FY28 subscription growth of ~11%, but upside likely comes in 2H FY28 at the earliest, more likely FY29. The stock has outperformed the median software stock by >7% over the past month.
WDAY reiterating the 11% FY28 subscription growth outlook after the C1.ai and Honeydew acquisitions could be read as an organic reduction.

ZM (EW): partner checks are in line to slightly ahead of plan and valuation is ~11x CY27 EV/FCF. MS expects Q3 revenue ~$15M above guidance (5.1% YoY) and FY27 revenue guide up ~$19M to ~$5.11B. The 6-8% FY30 growth target remains a high bar, and Microsoft Teams/E5 bundling poses renewal risk.

BOX (EW): stock has outperformed the median software stock by >15% in a month and trades at 16x CY28 FCF. A ~$2M beat would lift reported revenue growth from 9% in Q2 to 10% in Q3. Customer checks show AI resonating, but monetization pace is uncertain.
Valuation: SaaS apps software EV/NTM sales is 3.6x vs a 5-year average of 6.7x and broader software at 6.0x. High-growth SaaS trades at 12.7x vs a 13.2x 5-year average.
MS AlphaSignals flags likely upside surprises for DOCU, TTAN and ZM with modest EPS revisions higher, and in-line for WDAY and BOX.

market_movers.rationale: Tactically positive into Q3 on strong IAM monetization checks, conservative guide and 10x CY28 FCF.
Expects a strong beat and raise on HARDI data, warm weather and conservative GTV guidance.
Agentic AI is too small to lift growth near term and the stock has recently outperformed.
Better checks and cheap valuation, but the path to 6-8% FY30 growth is a high bar.
Momentum likely continues on accelerating growth, but monetization pace is uncertain.

sector_views.rationale: Industry view Attractive, but selective into off-quarter prints as the AI transition delays growth reacceleration.

earnings_insights: DOCU Q3 FY27 (upcoming): MS est revenue $888.1M vs consensus $889.5M, MS est EPS $1.18 vs consensus $1.19, billings est $918.1M vs consensus $858.6M.
ZM Q3 FY27 (upcoming): MS expects revenue ~$15M above guidance, 5.1% YoY growth, Enterprise growth ~8.3%, non-GAAP operating margin ~41% (~70bps above consensus).
BOX Q3 FY27 (upcoming): MS est revenue $329.4M vs consensus $329.2M, EPS $0.39 vs consensus $0.39. An assumed ~$2M beat to guidance implies ~10% reported growth.
TTAN Q3 FY27 (upcoming): MS est GTV $24,738M (+14.0% YoY) vs consensus $24,340M (+12.2%), platform revenue $279.1M in line with consensus, gross margin 76.4% vs consensus 74.7%.
WDAY Q3 FY27 (upcoming): subscription revenue expected in-line, EPS impact largely unchanged. WDAY has beaten revenue consensus by an average 0.6% over the last 4 quarters.
TTAN has beaten revenue consensus by an average 3.9% over the last 4 quarters, with a 5.2% average beat vs guidance.
ASAN Q3 FY27 (upcoming): MS est revenue $218.5M vs consensus $218.2M, EPS $0.09 vs consensus $0.09.
DSGX Q3 FY27 (upcoming): MS est total revenue $211.6M vs consensus $214.4M, below Street. Adj. EBITDA $97.7M vs consensus $97.4M.
IOT has beaten revenue consensus by an average 4.9% over the last 4 quarters, and CXM by 1.9%.
